subject: general
question: A 250-metre long train running at a speed of 100 km/h crosses another train coming from the opposite direction at a speed of 62 km/h in 10 seconds. What is the length of the second train?
solution:
**Given:**

The length of the first train is =250 meters.

The speed of the first long train =100 km/h.

The speed of the Second long train =62 km/h.

The required time of the second train=10 sec

**Formula Used:**

Distance=Speed × time
